An '''opera company''' consisting of members of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] toured across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="CoD" /> with the popular<ref name="Fact">{{FactFile|109|LEI 9-10|Leisure}}</ref> [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Opera/Legends|opera]] ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'',<ref name="CoD" /> beginning in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]]. Twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Datemath">''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' states that the company had been touring for twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], which, given that ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of the novel in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], indicates that the tour began in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]].</ref> the company performed the opera for its long-awaited return to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], occupying the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]].<ref name="CoD" />

The performance was attended by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], whose [[Parent/Legends|parents]] had underwritten ''The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths'', which raised the price of tickets. The company's packed performance was attended by many luminaries and other prominent [[Senator/Legends|senators]], including [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], as well as the senatorial [[Aide/Legends|aides]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]], [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], and Taa's [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] consort.<ref name="CoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bith opera company was first mentioned in ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', a [[2001]] novel by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="CoD" />
